items.title: Mrs. Charlotte Botney and Mrs. Bertha George McCullum Interview, 1960-10-16
items.q: The interviewer mentions 'Hayes numbers' in the context of Dixieland music, but the interviewee does not mention Hayes, nor does the interviewee indicate any personal connection, meeting, or collaboration with this person.

ctx.x: Hold the real law. And my daughter. Yeah, what you can tell me about my son. Oh, yeah.

He traveled. And he was. He was. He was what you call. A voice class get off man. He could play all the Dixieland. Yeah. Any one of them. I mean. You know. It's called that in the Raid books. When you have the music up. You play a few numbers. A few orchestrations. And then you say. Let's get in the Raid books now. And the guitar. That's where they get to play all the Hayes numbers. So he was a master, man. He was. He just was a voice class drummer. How was his range?
